captions_note: the checklist, window title, counter and label are the effect itself: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption / overall style before building. The reel's own captions are hidden while the slot plays (they sit mid-frame, half off the small card); the effect draws the spoken words on the card from words.json, so set cap_font, cap_weight, cap_case, cap_size, cap_color and cap_mark in STYLE to the buyer's caption style. CAPTIONS=0 draws none
in_a_reel: start the slot 2 to 4 frames before the line and leave F_IN = 3 and F_OUT = 'auto': the first and last frame are the plain picture and almost no spoken word falls outside the card. F_OUT = 'cut' only where the reel itself cuts on the slot's last frame
set FACE from a frame of assets/aroll.mp4 and look at one SAFE=1 snapshot: the checklist must not sit on the face (shorter steps make a narrower panel)
the slot needs about 105 frames plus 15 for the way back; build.py says how many when it is short
WINDOW_TITLE and PANEL_TAG are plain text in the buyer's words: no logo, no real product's interface
steps: do read the reel's own edit list (edl.json / plan.json) and write STEPS and SHOTS from it: only steps that were really done and the real length of every shot in frames. COUNT_TO, COUNT_LABEL and COUNT_NAME are only what the speaker says in this clip. Never invent a step, a count, a number or a name, never draw a logo. Nothing true to show = leave Pull-Back Reveal out and say so
run onsets.py      # 1. every word with its frame
edit the STYLE block and the CLIP block in build.py (true steps and shot lengths from the reel's edit list)
run build.py SAFE=1      # 2. page with the guide; prints every beat, the caption lines, the snapshot times
run check.py      # 4. frame count, plain edges, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
